1_collapse_partial_collapse_or_building_.description: The main structural elements, including the frame, beams, columns, and joints, appear intact with no visible collapse or foundation settlement.

4_chimney_parapet_or_other_falling_hazar.description: Falling hazards are present due to the collapse and detachment of infill walls, as well as exposed and damaged structural elements.

8_final_status.reasoning: Since Condition 3 (Racking) and Condition 4 (Falling Hazard) are evaluated as Severe, according to Table 31, the building must be posted Unsafe.
